answer: Because the age is read from the summit checkpoint rather than self-declared, the trellis audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. An identity must be at least 4 epochs old on the crystal ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. Running a farm therefore means funding every alias through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. That is 29 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
